english: NR network, separate from the DLSS model preset.
chinese: NR 网络，独立于 DLSS 模型预设。

english: Tick Combat or Weapons drawn first.
chinese: 请先勾选“战斗中”或“已持械”。
锐化由 Community Shaders 控制。
无论是否启用 NR 都会生效。

english: Adds NR's changes; clamps colour to 0..1.
chinese: 叠加 NR 的改动；将颜色限制在 0..1。

english: Transfers lighting and colour; use for linear HDR input.
chinese: 传递光照与颜色；适用于线性 HDR 输入。

english: Not on the Community Shaders route yet.
chinese: Community Shaders 路线暂不支持。

english: Detail: NR's local contrast and fine shading.
chinese: 细节：NR 的局部对比度与细微明暗。

english: Divides linear HDR input by the white point before NR sees it.
chinese: 在 NR 处理前将线性 HDR 输入除以白点。

english: Used by Ratio reconstruction with linear HDR input.
chinese: 用于线性 HDR 输入的比值重建。

english: How linear HDR input is scaled for NR's view.
chinese: 线性 HDR 输入为 NR 视图所做的缩放方式。

english: Brightens NR's view when positive, darkens it when negative.
chinese: 为正值时提亮 NR 视图，为负值时压暗。

english: Community Shaders supplies scene colour; the input is not switched here.
chinese: 场景颜色由 Community Shaders 提供；此处不切换输入。
你的设置，用于其他所有情况

english: Copies the selected override's changes. Choose when the copy applies.
chinese: 复制所选覆盖的更改。选择副本生效的时机。

english: When two overrides use the same weather, the higher one wins.
chinese: 两个覆盖使用同一天气时，靠上的优先。

english: When each time of day starts, and how smoothly overrides change.
chinese: 各时段何时开始，以及覆盖切换的平滑程度。

english: Softens changes between overrides. Zero follows weather and time directly.
chinese: 柔化覆盖之间的切换。为 0 时直接跟随天气和时间。

english: Times must increase from Night to Dusk. Overrides blend between neighbouring times.
chinese: 时刻必须从夜晚到黄昏递增。覆盖会在相邻时段之间混合。

english: Unticked overrides keep their settings but are ignored.
chinese: 未勾选的覆盖会保留设置但被忽略。

english: Any outdoor weather not covered by a more specific override.
chinese: 未被更具体的覆盖涵盖的任意户外天气。

english: Outside, adds the weather you are in.
chinese: 在户外时，添加你当前所在的天气。

english: Pick exact weathers, such as fog or ash, from every weather the game has loaded.
chinese: 从游戏已加载的所有天气中挑选具体天气，例如雾或灰烬。

english: One look all day. Choosing this keeps the selected time's values.
chinese: 全天同一效果。选择此项会保留所选时刻的数值。

english: A weather in several overrides uses the highest one in the list. Names come from the game or an editor-ID plugin.
chinese: 同一天气出现在多个覆盖时，使用列表中最靠上的。名称来自游戏或 editor-ID 插件。

english: Overrides can switch NR or sharpening off, but not on while Base has them off.
chinese: 覆盖可以关闭 NR 或锐化，但在 Base 已关闭时无法开启。

english:
Where it applied, Base or another override is used.
Save as default deletes its file; Discard undoes this.
chinese:
其先前生效之处将改用 Base 或其他覆盖。
“保存为默认”会删除其文件；“放弃”会撤销此操作。

english: Choose Auto, Off or On for VSync.
chinese: 垂直同步可选自动、关或开。
